headline: Research was thin today (most pages wouldn't open) and no API change breaks the bot, so there are two ideas from the bot's own code: make the tilt guard read every income row on busy days, and flag movers that have already used up their normal daily range.

ideas.title: Tilt guard reads every row on busy days
ideas.why: The guard asks Binance for the last 26 hours of income in one call capped at 1000 rows. On a heavy overtrading day, partial fills and fees can pass that cap and the newest rows — the revenge trades it exists to catch — may be missed. Page by time until a call returns fewer than 1000.

ideas.title: "Range used" flag on scanner cards
ideas.why: Top movers are often already done for the day. From the 4h candles the scanner already loads, compare today's high–low with the coin's average daily range over 14 days. Over 100% shows a "Range used" flag, so a late chase looks as risky as it is.

watch: Binance dropped the 'page' parameter from GET /fapi/v1/income (16 Oct 2026); paging now has to use startTime/endTime. guard.py already uses startTime only, so nothing breaks today.
